records.source: Provides unlimited access to all wallpapers and floors... from the convenience of your home!
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng walang limitasyong pagpili sa lahat ng papel na pandingding at pantakip sa sahig... mula mismo sa iyong tahanan!

records.source: Provides unlimited access to almost every furniture item... from the convenience of your home!
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng walang limitasyong pagpili sa halos lahat ng muwebles... mula mismo sa iyong tahanan!

records.source: You've found the {0}! It's covered in bug slime...
records.translation: Nahanap mo ang {0}! Balot ito ng malagkit na likido ng insekto...

records.source: You've found the Wizard's lost {0}! Better return it to him.
records.translation: Nahanap mo ang nawawalang {0} ng Mago! Mabuting ibalik ito sa kaniya.

records.source: You received the {0}! You now have the ability to find 'Secret Notes'. These notes reveal rare and useful information, and can be reviewed in your collections tab.
records.translation: Natanggap mo ang {0}! Maaari ka nang makahanap ng mga 'Lihim na Tala'. Nagbubunyag ang mga ito ng bihira at kapaki-pakinabang na impormasyon, at maaari mong balikan sa tab na Mga Koleksiyon.

records.source: You received the {0}! You feel an aura of good fortune surrounding you (luck is permanently increased)!
records.translation: Natanggap mo ang {0}! Nadarama mong napalilibutan ka ng magandang kapalaran (permanenteng tumaas ang suwerte)!

records.source: This package belongs to someone else.
records.translation: Pag-aari ng iba ang paketeng ito.

records.source: This can be planted to grow an oak tree.
records.translation: Maaari itong itanim upang magpatubo ng punong roble.

records.englishResidueReason: Remote and TV are standard Filipino consumer-electronics terms and make the item immediately recognizable.

records.source: It has more buttons than a regular remote. Perfect for the avid TV watcher!
records.translation: Mas marami itong pindutan kaysa sa karaniwang remote. Perpekto para sa masugid na manonood ng TV!
records.englishResidueReason: Remote and TV are standard Filipino consumer-electronics terms and preserve the item's natural everyday wording.

records.preserveReason: Aerinite is the proper mineral specimen name used by the game's museum collection.

records.translation: Kataka-takang magaan ang mga kristal na ito.

records.source: Fish eggs aged in salt to bring out the flavor.
records.translation: Mga itlog ng isda na pinaedad sa asin upang lumabas ang lasa.

records.preserveReason: Alamite is the proper mineral specimen name used by the game's museum collection.

records.source: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.
records.translation: Dahil sa natatanging pagkinang nito, paborito ito ng mga kolektor ng bato.

records.source: Prefers temperature "edges" where cool and warm water meet.
records.translation: Mas gusto nito ang mga "hangganan" ng temperatura kung saan nagtatagpo ang malamig at mainit na tubig.

records.source: A purple grain cultivated by an ancient civilization.
records.translation: Lilang butil na nilinang ng isang sinaunang kabihasnan.

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 7 days to grow. Harvest with the scythe.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 7 araw upang lumaki. Anihin gamit ang Karit.
